description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface, specifically testing the getBufferAvailable method. It includes mock expectations, test cases for success, failure, and reconnection scenarios, and uses Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoClientWebAudioPlayerIpcGetBufferAvailableTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from WebAudioPlayerIpcTestBase, setting up and tearing down the WebAudio IPC environment for each test.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates WebAudioPlayer IPC, and initializes shared memory info.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by destroying WebAudioPlayer IPC.
